title: Harvard Square Dining Guide
snippet: Harvard Square offers a dense mix of casual, student-budget-friendly restaurants alongside higher-end dining options.
full_text: Harvard Square's dining scene ranges from casual, student-budget-friendly spots — pizza, bubble tea, and fast-casual chains — to a smaller number of higher-end restaurants, giving students a wide range of price points within walking distance.
claim_text: Harvard Square offers a dense mix of student-budget-friendly restaurants and cafes alongside higher-end dining options.
